title: This is my lake monologue from Act II of Purpose #wutheringheights
transcript: Watching a film like Wuthering Heights as an ace person is always so interesting to me because I don't find Jacob Elordi or Margot Robbie sexually attractive. They're just aesthetically good looking people. But the action of the corset lift? Hot, hot!
classificationReason: Despite the title referencing the stage play 'Purpose,' the transcript content discusses the Wuthering Heights film (Jacob Elordi, Margot Robbie) — a film review, not a stage production review.
